Women’s Black Oversized T-Shirt – Capri Lobster Graphic Print

Upgrade your casual wardrobe with this trendy women’s oversized T-shirt featuring a bold Capri lobster graphic print. The relaxed silhouette provides a comfortable, effortless look, making it ideal for everyday wear, vacations, travel and streetwear styling.

Key Features:

Stylish Capri lobster graphic print
Classic black color
Trendy oversized/relaxed fit
Comfortable round neck
Short sleeves
Soft and breathable feel
Lightweight and easy to wear
Perfect for casual and streetwear looks
Easy to pair with shorts, jeans, joggers or skirts
Suitable for everyday outings, travel and vacation wear

Product Details:

Color: Black
Print: Capri Lobster Graphic
Fit: Oversized / Relaxed Fit
Neck: Round Neck
Sleeves: Short Sleeves
Style: Casual / Streetwear

Care Instructions: Machine wash or gentle wash. Wash dark colors separately. Avoid using bleach. Dry in shade for better color retention.
